aboutParagraphs: I'm Shaniya Fonseka, a freelance Mobile Videographer, Content Creator and Digital Media Creative based in Sri Lanka.

I specialise in mobile videography, photography, creative video editing, graphic design and social media content creation. My experience includes promotional campaigns, brand collaborations, event productions and creative media projects.
I've also worked in assistant direction and scriptwriting, bringing creative ideas to life through visual storytelling.
I enjoy transforming simple concepts into engaging visuals, meaningful stories and creative digital experiences. For me, every project is an opportunity to create something meaningful.

faqs.question: What services does SF Creations offer?
faqs.answer: SF Creations offers Mobile Videography, Content Creation, Social Media Content Creation, Video Editing, Photography, Graphic Design, Assistant Direction, and Scriptwriting for brands, events, and creative projects in Sri Lanka.

faqs.question: How can I request a booking?
faqs.answer: You can submit your project details through the Booking & Project Inquiry form on this website or reach out directly via WhatsApp or email. All inquiries are reviewed personally before availability and bookings are confirmed.

faqs.question: How is pricing calculated?
faqs.answer: Every project is quoted individually based on your specific requirements, shoot duration, location, creative scope, and deliverables. Submit an inquiry with your brief to receive a tailored custom quote.

faqs.question: Do you work with businesses and individual clients?
faqs.answer: Yes. SF Creations collaborates with corporate brands, salons, retail businesses, hospitality venues, event organisers, production teams, and individual clients looking for high-quality creative media.

faqs.question: How long does a project take?
faqs.answer: Timelines depend on the nature and complexity of the project, shoot requirements, and editing or design scope. Expected delivery schedules are discussed and agreed upon clearly during your consultation.

faqs.question: Can I request customised creative services?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. If your project requires a combination of mobile videography, graphic design, scriptwriting, or assistant direction, you can select Custom Creative Projects in the inquiry form and outline your vision.

faqs.question: How can I share my project requirements?
faqs.answer: Use the Booking & Project Inquiry form to share your preferred date, service type, and project overview. Once submitted, we can also exchange moodboards, references, and scripts via email or WhatsApp.

faqs.question: How do I contact SF Creations?
faqs.answer: You can reach Shaniya Fonseka directly via WhatsApp on 072 3260085, by email at sfcreations26@gmail.com, or through Instagram (@_shaniya_fonseka_), TikTok (@shaniyafonseka), and LinkedIn.
